title: Astrophysics for People in a Hurry
author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

adhd.label: Step 1 · Ch. 1: The Greatest Story Ever Told — The First Second of the Universe
adhd.brief: Rewinds the entire cosmos into a subatomic point 13.8 billion years ago and watches gravity, quarks, electrons, and light separate as the universe cools.

adhd.label: Step 2 · Jumps to Ch. 7: The Cosmos on the Periodic Table
adhd.brief: Jumps to the chemistry of the stars, tracing how hydrogen from the Big Bang was fused inside stellar cores into the carbon, oxygen, and iron inside your own hands.

adhd.label: Step 3 · Jumps Back to Ch. 5–6: Dark Matter & Dark Energy (The Invisible 95%)
adhd.brief: Follows Vera Rubin and Fritz Zwicky as they discover that visible stars and gas make up less than 5% of the cosmos, held together by invisible dark matter and pushed apart by dark energy.

adhd.label: Step 4 · Jumps to Ch. 12: Reflections on the Cosmic Perspective
adhd.brief: Closes with Tyson's liberating cosmic zoom-out on why remembering our atomic kinship with the universe dissolves small ego worries.
